file: 364 He Walked for 14 Years to Reach the Edge of Minecraft.mp4

lines.t: This guy walked in one direction in Minecraft for 14 years.

full.credit: Clips: Far Lands or Bust; AntVenom (YouTube)

lines.t: In March 2011, Kurt J Mac started walking toward the Far Lands. The glitched edge of the old Minecraft world.

full.credit: Clips: Far Lands or Bust; AntVenom (YouTube)

lines.say: In March 2011, Kurt J Mac started walking toward the Far Lands. The glitched edge of the old Minecraft world.

lines.t: They start about 12 and a half million blocks from spawn. He walked the whole way, live, raising money for charity.

full.credit: Clips: Far Lands or Bust; AntVenom (YouTube)

lines.t: On October 4th, 2025, he finally reached them. And raised over half a million dollars on the way.

full.credit: Clips: Far Lands or Bust; AntVenom (YouTube)

lines.t: Would you walk 14 years for this?

full.credit: Clips: Far Lands or Bust; AntVenom (YouTube)
